description: 14-paper document-input pilot: 11 curated IPI scopes plus 3 unrelated topic-screening negatives. Expected labels are evaluation metadata only and must never enter extraction prompts. The 11 curated labels are copied unchanged from paper_pilot_gold.json and may rely on code or archived evidence beyond the linked PDF; compare them as historical full-evidence targets, not as ground truth for PDF-only detection accuracy. The three out-of-domain labels mean the IPI-specific audit is not applicable, not that the paper is globally consistent or free of flaws. Retrieval Barrier is the existing narrow in-domain consistent example, not an additional independent negative. These development papers are not a held-out test set.
